(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (rect-border? obj)
      (let* ((bb (obj-bbox obj))
             (h (+ (- (third bb) (first bb)) 1))
             (w (+ (- (fourth bb) (second bb)) 1))
             (border-size (- (* h w) (* (max 0 (- h 2)) (max 0 (- w 2))))))
        (and (>= (obj-size obj) 8)
             (= (obj-size obj) border-size)
             (all? (lambda (p)
                     (or (= (first p) (first bb)) (= (first p) (third bb))
                         (= (second p) (second bb)) (= (second p) (fourth bb))))
                   (obj-cells obj)))))
    (let* ((frame (first (filter rect-border? (objects g 0))))
           (bb (obj-bbox frame))
           (interior (filter (lambda (cell)
                               (let ((v (third cell)))
                                 (and (not (= v 0))
                                      (> (first cell) (first bb))
                                      (< (first cell) (third bb))
                                      (> (second cell) (second bb))
                                      (< (second cell) (fourth bb)))))
                             (grid-cells g)))
           (a (third (first interior)))
           (b (third (second interior)))
           (with-border (paint-cells (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0) (obj-cells frame) (obj-color frame))))
      (for*/fold ([out with-border])
                 ([r (in-range (+ (first bb) 1) (third bb))]
                  [c (in-range (+ (second bb) 1) (fourth bb))])
        (set-cell out r c
                  (if (= (modulo (+ (- r (+ (first bb) 1)) (- c (+ (second bb) 1))) 2) 0) a b))))))

(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (rect-border? obj)
      (let* ((bb (obj-bbox obj))
             (h (+ (- (third bb) (first bb)) 1))
             (w (+ (- (fourth bb) (second bb)) 1))
             (border-size (- (* h w) (* (max 0 (- h 2)) (max 0 (- w 2))))))
        (and (>= (obj-size obj) 8)
             (= (obj-size obj) border-size)
             (all? (lambda (p)
                     (or (= (first p) (first bb)) (= (first p) (third bb))
                         (= (second p) (second bb)) (= (second p) (fourth bb))))
                   (obj-cells obj)))))
    (let* ((frame (first (filter rect-border? (objects g 0))))
           (bb (obj-bbox frame))
           (top (first bb))
           (left (second bb))
           (bottom (third bb))
           (right (fourth bb))
           (ih (- bottom top 1))
           (iw (- right left 1))
           (interior (filter (lambda (cell)
                               (let ((v (third cell)))
                                 (and (not (= v 0))
                                      (> (first cell) top)
                                      (< (first cell) bottom)
                                      (> (second cell) left)
                                      (< (second cell) right))))
                             (grid-cells g)))
           (a (third (first interior)))
           (b (third (second interior)))
           (with-border (paint-cells (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)
                                     (obj-cells frame) (obj-color frame)))
           (stage (for*/fold ([out with-border])
                             ([r (in-range (+ top 1) bottom)]
                              [c (in-range (+ left 1) right)])
                    (set-cell out r c
                              (if (= (modulo (+ (- r (+ top 1))
                                                (- c (+ left 1))) 2) 0)
                                  a b))))
           (markers (filter (lambda (cell) (= (third cell) 8)) (grid-cells g))))
      (for/fold ([out stage]) ([marker markers])
        (let ((mr (first marker))
              (mc (second marker)))
          (cond
            ((< mc left)
             (for/fold ([acc out]) ([tc (in-range (- left iw) left)])
               (let ((sc (+ (+ left 1) (- tc (- left iw)))))
                 (set-cell acc mr tc (at stage mr sc)))))
            ((> mc right)
             (for/fold ([acc out]) ([tc (in-range (+ right 1) (+ right iw 1))])
               (let ((sc (+ (+ left 1) (- tc (+ right 1)))))
                 (set-cell acc mr tc (at stage mr sc)))))
            ((< mr top)
             (for/fold ([acc out]) ([tr (in-range (- top ih) top)])
               (let ((sr (+ (+ top 1) (- tr (- top ih)))))
                 (set-cell acc tr mc (at stage sr mc)))))
            (else
             (for/fold ([acc out]) ([tr (in-range (+ bottom 1) (+ bottom ih 1))])
               (let ((sr (+ (+ top 1) (- tr (+ bottom 1)))))
                 (set-cell acc tr mc (at stage sr mc)))))))))))
